name: Semiosis Form Builder
author: semiosissoftware

sections.description:
Semiosis Form Builder is a modern drag & drop WordPress form builder plugin designed for speed, flexibility, and unlimited usage.

Create contact forms, lead forms, inquiry forms, feedback forms, file upload forms, booking forms, and custom forms without coding.

Features include AJAX submission, entry management, email notifications, file uploads, spam protection, and unlimited forms — completely free forever.

Developed by Semiosis Software Private Limited.

Developer: Nirmal Audichya
Website: https://www.semiosissoftware.com/
Support: plugins@semiosissoftware.com

Features

  • Drag & Drop Form Builder
  • Unlimited Forms & Entries
  • AJAX Form Submission
  • File Upload Support
  • Email Notifications
  • Auto Reply Emails
  • Entry Management
  • Spam Protection
  • Honeypot Security
  • Mobile Responsive
  • Shortcode Support
  • Fast & Lightweight

Supported Fields

  • Text
  • Email
  • Phone
  • Textarea
  • Select
  • Checkbox
  • Radio
  • File Upload
  • Hidden Field
  • HTML Block

External services

This plugin can connect to Google reCAPTCHA v3 to help prevent spam form submissions.

It sends the visitor’s IP address and reCAPTCHA verification data to Google when reCAPTCHA is enabled on a form and the form is submitted.

This service is provided by Google:

Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms

Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/semiosis-form-builder/ directory, or install through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to “Semiosis Forms” in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Create your form using the drag & drop builder.
  5. Copy and paste the shortcode anywhere on your website.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes. All features are completely free forever.

Does it support AJAX forms?

Yes. Forms submit using AJAX without page reload.

Can I upload files?

Yes. The plugin supports secure file uploads.

Does it store entries?

Yes. All submissions are stored inside WordPress admin.

Is coding knowledge required?

No. You can build forms visually using drag & drop.
